scanner.rate: approximately 2 target requests/sec, one request at a time; no lockout or DoS workload
scanner.knownLimits: No external-target traffic; kernel egress permits the product adapter only to the verified backend address:8080.

techniqueRationale.selected: Risk-based native SQLi for numeric and credential boundaries; deeper MEDIUM textual search/login, selected JSON reflection with LOW alert threshold, native valid-phone script, header fuzzing and semantic controls.
techniqueRationale.notSelected: No XML parsing sink (application/xml returned 415), user-selected outbound URL/file/template/OS-command sink was discovered on public handlers. Browser/DOM exploitation is outside BE-only scope. Choices come from source/input behavior, not the common executor rule whitelist.
techniqueRationale.runnerChoice: Guided MCP was used for native GET scans. Its actual anonymous schema has no method/postData fields. The research executor restricts products/rules and private registration to duplicate baselines. A fresh ByteMe adapter reused native ascan, exact SiteNode binding, MCP report reader, journal and owned Docker cleanup without changing shared core gates.
techniqueRationale.inputAdaptation: For each registration mutation, the target field is preserved, fresh non-target credential fields prevent uniqueness blockers, and password/confirmation are synchronized. Login uses fresh real CUSTOMER credentials; issued tokens are never sent on subsequent requests. Each successful create remains a real application request; no attack response cache is used. Login fixtures are reused until their observed quota requires rotation.

alertSummary.counting: A group is native pluginId + severity + confidence. Instances are all distinct current native alert IDs; the standard report includes bounded samples and its smaller instance count is not the denominator.

limitations.detail: Completion means the discovered public backend operations and their selected applicable input techniques were executed and reconciled. It does not certify absence of vulnerabilities or exhaust every payload/rule combination.

limitations.scope: authenticated APIs, BOLA and frontend execution
limitations.detail: Only BE anonymous was requested. Protected calls are denial controls. No authenticated business traffic or browser exploitation was performed.
Docker Compose labels, origin, health and runtime OpenAPI matched the supplied project. Source HEAD was recorded; exact application image-to-source build attestation is unavailable.

Guard denied method changes, out-of-case routes, extra path segments and decoded slash/CR/LF variants. They receive no delivered application coverage credit. Public input coverage is based on the actually delivered field/path mutations, not scan progress or those denied probes.

Native advisory fingerprinting and hardening alerts are retained at native severity/confidence. Exploit reachability and external advisory accuracy were not independently established. Generic /error and JavaScript numeric matches have no demonstrated sensitive disclosure impact.

41 accounts created by this run are retained. No public account deletion API exists in discovered source/spec; authenticated/admin cleanup or DB deletion would extend this BE-anonymous task. Private identifiers are retained locally for later authorized cleanup.

securityConclusion: Native findings retained with context; no claim of product safety. Selected question completion follows current reconciliation.

cleanup.privateRetention: Working root access restricted to owner after owned scanner containers were removed; raw credentials retained private.

retainedFixtures.credentialMaterial: Local private only; no credentials, tokens or cookies included here.

fixturePlanning.basis: Previous successful native creates and baselines restricted to newly selected rule sets; login fixture rotation from observed quota. Forecast only, not a pass threshold or coverage source. LOW alert threshold may change rule behavior.
fixturePlanning.planningTiming: Reconstructed from prior working traffic after current execution; future discovery records this before workload.
fixturePlanning.retentionReason: No public account delete API; do not perform DB/admin deletion outside this track.
